t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Certain colour gnomes correspond to certain colour baskets. When you see baskets decreasing in value then switch tactics

vb_textbox.text: Half of the gnomes correspond to the yellow basket and the other half relate to the red baskets. Gnomes that are closest to red colours correspond to the baskets and gnomes closest to yellow correspond to yellow baskets. The value of the baskets change over time, so keep an eye on the values of the baskets and switch to the alternative colour as the value reduces
